title: The Future of the Internal Combustion Engine - /INSIDE KOENIGSEGG
summary: Episode 7 of the Inside Koenigsegg series, where Christian von Koenigsegg demonstrates the camless Free Valve engine technology. It discusses how such innovation could affect the wider auto industry.
why: Cited in threads on camless, digital valve and free-piston engines as a look at Koenigsegg's freevalve work.

quote.text: For those of you interested in seeing some more details on Koenigsegg's work with their freevalve engine
